svg.title: Coral Market — Shell-awning crescent
svg.desc: Five craft stalls arc around a loading court. Shell roofs, fish crates and kelp-rope catwalks connect the smith, armorer, provisions and arcane galleries. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

svg.text: Five craft stalls arc around a loading court. Shell roofs, fish crates and kelp-rope
catwalks connect the smith, armorer, provisions and arcane galleries.
